full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiffs opposite parties herein is interalia that the original owner of the land mentioned in tic schedule below was one Ramjan Ali and that C .S Khatian No 23 was finally published in his name. The said Ramjan Ali died leaving behind two sons namely Gura Miah and Syed Ali and two daughters namely, Sabur Khatun and Sadar Nisa alias Khatuni as his legal heirs. That during the time of R. S operation the said two daughters of Ramjan Ali were at their husbands house for which their names could not be recorded in the R S Khatians. But in spite of that they were in joint possession with their brothers Syed Ali and Gura Miah and. that the said Sadar Nisa alias Khatuni, Syed Ali, Thanda Miah, Abul Khatun and Tambia Khatun sold out 2.00 acres of land to plaintiff No 1 for their legal necessity including the schedule land vide registered kabala dated 9. 5. 1966 and delivered possession thereof to him and since the date of purchase the plaintiff No 1 is in peaceful possession of the same by paying rents, revenues etc. to the Government. Then he filed a Mutation Case No 572/11 of 1967-68 before the Circle Officer Hathazari, Chittagong who ordered for mutation of his name in S A Record but subsequently it was lost. Similarly the plaintiff No 2 also purchased .80 acre of land vide Registered kabala deeds dated 23.1.1984 and the plaintiff No 3 purchased .20 acre of land vide Registered kabala deed dated 23.1.1984 from one Bazal Ahmed, Oli Ahmed, Kabir Ahmed, Thanda Meah, Abul Khatun, Saleh Ahmed and Nur Begum on payment of proper consideration money and since then they are in peaceful possession of their purchased lands including .15 acre of the schedule land on payment of rent, to the Government. That the names of the plaintiff Nos. 2 and 3 were also recorded in the S.A Khatian through Mutation and the names of all the plaintiffs subsequently were recorded in present revisional survey khatian vide Appeal Case No 28876 of 1982. Out of the purchased lands of the plaintiff .30 acre as mentioned in the schedule has been acquired by the Government vide L. A Case No 128 of 1983-84 (Misc. Case No 2 of 1984-85) for Gas line which was in the possession of the plaintiffs and the compensation money for the said acquisition has been assessed at Tk. 188442/-and that the plaintiffs are entitled to get the said compensation money and accordingly they filed a petition to the Land Acquisition Officer for getting the compensation money. It appears that the original defendant Nos. 1 to 3 who also claimed to have purchased some land of the R. S Khatian from said Syed Ali and Gura Meah lodged a claim for the compensation money, besides some other groups of peoples have also applied for getting their alleged shares in the compensation money and the Land Acquisition Officer after hearing all the parties passed his order on 12.10.1985 and awarded compensation to only defendants 1 to 3 and hence the present suit by the plaintiffs.
